one_line: One cover every 2 to 3 seconds, a hand sliding each away, one theme label each: an easy solo list.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down static shot: a hardcover with a wide-eyed rabbit on a stack of books on a wooden floor, a hand touches it at 0:01. No speech. Label at the bottom from 0:00: "התמודדות עם פחדים 💪".
q1_hook.why: A large, clear cover with a label in the first frame meets the skip test (H1, T3) and the book is handled at once (S1). But the label names one book's theme, not the list or the back-to-school occasion, so the topic is unclear until the caption (H2). No voice or face (H4).

beats.what: Rabbit cover, a hand touches it; "התמודדות עם פחדים 💪"
beats.why: First book and its theme arrive together.

beats.what: A hand slides book one away; koala cover; "יציאה מאזור הנוחות 🐨"
beats.why: The slide is the reveal, a repeatable rhythm.
A new cover and theme, same move.

beats.what: Mole in autumn leaves cover; "חברות וקשרים 🎁"
beats.why: Longest hold, 3 s, with a hand on the cover.

beats.what: Red strawberry board book with a lion; "גמישות מול שינויים 🍓"
beats.why: The format changes from hardcover to board book.

beats.what: Turtle cover held still, hand away; "אמפתיה והתחשבות באחר 🐢"
beats.why: Ends on the last item, no wrap-up.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: "איזה ספר הייתן מוסיפות לרשימה שלנו?🥰". The video asks nothing. The six themed books are saveable, but no save or send is asked.
q2_flow.why: The same move six times gives a new cover every 2 to 3 s and a predictable rhythm (R3, R1). At 15 s it is easy to finish (R2). Each beat only names a theme, so nothing builds to a peak and the end has no payoff (K2, R4). A themed list is worth sending or saving (R5, R7).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. Caption: "איזה ספר הייתן מוסיפות לרשימה שלנו?🥰", a promise that each book gets a few words soon, and a starred note pointing to the highlight "המלצות קריאה".
q3_cta.why: The caption question is open, answerable from a parent's life, and has a purpose: recommendations (C5, C2). The highlight pointer adds a second, softer action (C1). Neither is said or shown in the video, so a viewer at 0:15 gets no prompt (C6).

q4_shown.what: Six covers of existing Hebrew picture books, one at a time, top-down on a wooden floor, a hand with rings touching or sliding each. A theme label per book. No pages opened, no child, no voice, no price.
q4_shown.why: A theme per cover tells a parent why each book helps, a real concern, not a plug (K4, K6). Covers fill the frame and are readable (F4). With no page, reaction or first-person verdict, the expert role rests on the account handle alone (S6).

q5_edit.what: One continuous take, no cuts detected: a hand slides each book away to reveal the next, six reveals of 2 to 3 s, camera static. Labels swap with each book, with a gap at 0:02. Last book held about 3 s. No end card.
q5_edit.why: The in-frame slide is a clean, fast reveal with no hard cuts (E2, R3). Labels carry the message, so it works muted (T1). The still 3 s on the last book is a tail with no payoff (E8). Sound does not carry the message (E4).

q6_topic.what: Six picture books, each tied to a theme for talking about a new school year (caption: "לקראת 1.9"). Serves a parent or teacher preparing for school.
q6_topic.why: A dated, shared moment and themes that name real worries (fears, belonging, friendship) make parents feel helped (K6, K7). A themed list suits a save or a send to a teacher (R5, R7). There is no peak feeling (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Static top-down phone shot over a stack of hardcover books on a light wooden floor, daylight. One hand with rings and a bracelet slides each book. No face, no child. Thin black bars, about 5% at top and bottom.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands and no child is the easy first-choice format (S4, F5, S5). Covers are large enough to read (F4). The black bars mean it does not fill the 9:16 frame (F1, H7, F3).

q8_text.on_screen: One label per book, white bold text with an emoji, centred about 87% down the frame: "התמודדות עם פחדים 💪" (0:00), "יציאה מאזור הנוחות 🐨" (0:03), "שייכות וקבלה ⭐" (0:05), "חברות וקשרים 🎁" (0:07), "גמישות מול שינויים 🍓" (0:10), "אמפתיה והתחשבות באחר 🐢" (0:12). No headline, no subtitles.
q8_text.caption: "לקראת 1.9, בחרנו כמה ספרים שיכולים לעזור לנו לפתוח עם הילדים שיחות על התחלה חדשה ❤️📚". About 55 words: themes, a promise of more on each book, a question, a highlight note. No hashtags, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: Short labels held 2 to 3 s are readable and carry the whole message, so it works muted (T5, T1, T2). They sit in the bottom 35%, and the emoji sits at the right where reading starts (T4, F2, T6). The caption adds the occasion and themes the Reel lacks (T7).

weak_points: No headline naming the list or the occasion; no voice, pages or reaction; labels in the bottom band with the emoji leading; black bars top and bottom; no CTA in the video; a still hold at the end.
lumebook_takeaway: Film covers top-down on a table, a hand sliding each away, one label per cover naming the occasion; add a headline first and a CTA last.
not_verified: The books' authors and publishers; what the audio is (no speech, no sticker or lyrics; the track is not silent, mean volume -16.6 dB, so likely music; the transcript's "תודה רבה." is a false output); that the creator is a speech therapist (handle only). Corrections to the first pass: the file has black bars of 88 px at top and bottom (crop detection); the label disappears at 0:02 between books; the labels sit about 87% down, not just the lower third. Plays 3,129, likes 45 on 15 Oct are context only.
